popCulture.title: Agapenor
popCulture.description: Son of Ancaeus, Arcadian king who led Tegea and the highlanders to Troy — later founder of New Paphos and the Cypriot cult of Aphrodite in post-Homeric tradition.

popCulture.title: Catalogue of Ships
popCulture.description: Iliad 2 names Agapenor captain of the Arcadians — sixty ships of inland fighters who needed Agamemnon's vessels to reach Troy.

popCulture.title: Paphos
popCulture.description: The Cypriot city Agapenor is said to have founded after the war — Arcadia transplanted to Aphrodite's island.

popCulture.title: Aphrodite
popCulture.description: The goddess whose Cypriot sanctuary Pausanias links to Agapenor's Arcadian settlement at Paphos.
